description:
emit_ordering_cmp_value (integer fast path, else fz_value_cmp_ref) replaces emit_int_cmp_value in the JIT/AOT receive matcher, which unboxes float references as integers. Independent of the raises: ticket.

Fails before, passes after: a JIT or AOT receive 'n when n > 1.5' with message 2.0 fails to compile at base; 'n < :b' with 1 also fails to compile on run and build ('expected int receive value'); the interpreter and Elixir answer :a. Fixture 01092.

Acceptance: full gate green; no pin rises.
title: The receive matcher orders by the dynamic comparison
